message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to external services like VirusTotal or the ability to make authenticated API calls on your behalf. If you’d like to look up the CAA records for `instagram.com` yourself, you can do so with a DNS query:

```bash
dig +short instagram.com CAA
```

or by using an online DNS lookup tool (e.g., https://dns.google/lookup). If you want to automate this via the VirusTotal API, you’ll need to send a GET request to their “Domain Details” endpoint (`https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}`) with your API key in the `x-apikey` header. Once you have the JSON response, you can parse out the `"certificates"` section to see the CAA information.

Let me know if you’d like help crafting the exact HTTP request or parsing the response!
